notes: Beta: updating no longer disconnects your listeners. The radio server now keeps running while the app restarts itself, so instead of everyone being dropped and having to reconnect, they keep their connection and hear a few seconds of quiet. It'll also offer to wait until the current song finishes, so the gap lands between tracks. And when a song turns out to be the wrong recording or a bad-sounding rip, right-click it and choose "Find another version" — you get a handful of other uploads to listen to, 30 seconds each, and the one you pick replaces it while keeping its place in your playlists and its play count.
